about.title: Burlingame Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Burlingame residents rely on all sorts of products every day, from kitchen appliances in homes along Chapin Avenue to power tools used by contractors near California Drive. When a product is designed poorly, built with a flaw, or sold without adequate warnings, the people who use it can be seriously hurt through no fault of their own. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a strict liability claim, meaning the focus is on whether the product itself was defective, not on proving carelessness by the manufacturer. We help Burlingame residents understand how these claims work, including the importance of preserving the product and any packaging as evidence. We never guarantee results, but we can help you take a clear next step after a product injury, whether it happened at home, at work, or somewhere in between.

items.title: Strict Liability Focus
items.desc: California's strict liability standard generally means you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless, only that the product was defective and caused your injury. We can help identify which type of defect applies to your situation.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and even the retailer that sold the product in Burlingame can potentially be held responsible. This gives you more than one avenue to pursue when a defective product causes harm.

items.title: Evidence Preservation Guidance
items.desc: Keeping the product, its packaging, and any related receipts intact after an injury is often critical to a claim. Our team can advise you early on how to protect this evidence before it's lost or discarded.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Generally, no. California product liability claims often rely on strict liability, which focuses on whether the product itself was defective rather than on the manufacturer's conduct. We can evaluate whether a design, manufacturing, or warning defect applies to your case.

items.question: What should I do with the product that injured me in Burlingame?
items.answer: Try to preserve the product exactly as it was at the time of the injury, including packaging, instructions, and any receipts. Avoid attempting repairs or discarding it, since this evidence can be important for our team when reviewing your claim.

items.question: How does your firm work?
items.answer: We handle product liability cases directly and typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. Contact us to discuss your injury and learn more about how we can help.
